title: A unified and domain-robust framework enables controllable multimodal brain MRI synthesis

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A unified and domain-robust framework enables controllable multimodal brain MRI synthesis》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Multimodal magnetic resonance image (MRI) synthesis can shorten examinations, reduce cost, and furnish contrasts that are difficult or impossible to acquire, but current models remain hard to control and brittle to shifts in scanner, protocol, and pathology.
